title: adhatoda tranquebariensis
intro: Adhatoda tranquebariensis, commonly known as 'Vasaka', is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its diverse health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda tranquebariensis include expectorant and bronchodilatory effects, which help in relieving cough and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like vasicine and vasicinone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
